tasks.CalculatePerimeter: Calculate the perimeter using the found values of L and B.
tasks.DefineVariables: Define the variables for length (L) and breadth (B) of the rectangle based on given conditions.
tasks.FormulateEquation: Formulate an equation using the area and relationship between L and B to find their values.
tasks.SolveEquations: Solve the quadratic equation derived from the formulated equation to find the values of L and B.
